memberdef.argsstring: (unsigned Major, unsigned Minor, unsigned Subminor, unsigned Build)
memberdef.name: VersionTuple

briefdescription.para: Determine whether this version information is empty (e.g., all version components are zero).
Retrieve the minor version number, if provided.
Retrieve the subminor version number, if provided.
Retrieve the build version number, if provided.
Return a version tuple that contains only the first 3 version components.
Return a version tuple that contains a different major version but everything else is the same.
Return a version tuple that contains only components that are non-zero.
Retrieve a string representation of the version number.
Try to parse the given string as a version number.

simplesect.para: true if the string does not match the regular expression [0-9]+(.[0-9]+){0,3}

briefdescription.para: Determine if two version numbers are equivalent.

detaileddescription.para: If not provided, minor and subminor version numbers are considered to be zero.

briefdescription.para: Determine if two version numbers are not equivalent.

detaileddescription.para: If not provided, minor and subminor version numbers are considered to be zero.

briefdescription.para: Determine whether one version number precedes another.

detaileddescription.para: If not provided, minor and subminor version numbers are considered to be zero.

briefdescription.para: Determine whether one version number follows another.

detaileddescription.para: If not provided, minor and subminor version numbers are considered to be zero.

briefdescription.para: Determine whether one version number precedes or is equivalent to another.

detaileddescription.para: If not provided, minor and subminor version numbers are considered to be zero.

briefdescription.para: Determine whether one version number follows or is equivalent to another.

detaileddescription.para: If not provided, minor and subminor version numbers are considered to be zero.

briefdescription.para: Represents a version number in the form major[.minor[.subminor[.build]]].
